indicator.name: Cboe Volatility Index (VIX)
indicator.description: The options-implied expected 30-day volatility of the S&P 500.
indicator.methodology: Cboe VIX closing level. The component is contrarian: higher VIX (more fear) maps to a higher score through an inverse historical percentile.
indicator.limitations: Elevated VIX is not proof that equities are cheap. VIX measures implied volatility and can remain elevated during prolonged drawdowns. It is a supplementary sentiment and risk indicator.
